environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on an EC2 instance behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with no web application firewall. The NLB operates at Layer 4 (TCP) and passes all HTTP traffic directly to the application without any content inspection. Security groups allow inbound traffic on port 443/80 from 0.0.0.0/0. No Content-Security-Policy headers are configured at the infrastructure level.
